title: feat(security): the owner assigns staff roles through Runtime, and every assignment is recorded (SEC-1e, ADR-0043)

sourceMetadata.subject: feat(security): the owner assigns staff roles through Runtime, and every assignment is recorded (SEC-1e, ADR-0043)
sourceMetadata.body:
Implements ADR-0043 Decision 3. Runtime holds the Supabase service role key and exposes the real user directory and staff role assignment: GET /api/admin/users and POST /api/admin/users/:id/role, for a super admin identified by a verified session (or the configured development identity on this machine) only. A role is written to app_metadata through the Supabase admin API, keeping the user's other app_metadata, and recorded in runtime/governance/role-assignments with from, to, reason, who and when. Refused: callers who are not super admin, header claims, plan roles (assigned by billing, BILL-1), unknown roles, a missing reason, no change, and removing the last super admin. With real sign-in, Admin > Users is now this directory with a reason dialog and recent assignments; the demo directory remains for the development-only mock sign-in. Verified live against a stand-in Supabase admin server; runtime suites 444/444.
